notes.content:
Get ready to create wild themed sex parties in exotic locations all around the world in Pleasure Party 2.

Pleasure Party 2 takes the orgy-tastic fun of the first Pleasure Party to the next level. Add it to your wishlist now!

notes.title: WanderLust Major Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
WanderLust on STEAM has now been updated to version 1.1, which includes a number of exciting changes. Here is what is included.

A new "Gallery" button on the Main Menu, that allows you to revisit the Erotic scenes in the game once you have completed them. (NOTE: If you have already started/completed the game and don't see any buttons available in the gallery, just load up your most recent save file for a moment, and then exit back to the menu. The game will scan your save file and give you access to all of the scenes you have completed.)

A number of new options available for adjusting the gameplay experience including:
[list]
[*] Directional Arrows that can be turned on or off from the "Options" menu. When enabled, green directional arrows will appear on the ground throughout the game, pointing you to the next major objective. Keep in mind that these only point to the Major Objectives, and if you strictly follow these and don't do any exploring, you may miss out on some of the game experience.
[*] The "One shot kill" cheat. If you are struggling with battles, or simply want to make them go by faster, you can check this box on the "Options" page and Elise will kill every bad-guy with her first attack.
[*] The "No Bad Guys" cheat. If you don't want to encounter bad guys at all, and simply want to freely run from one area to another in the game, you can enable this cheat on the "Options" screen. Note that if you turn this feature on, and then turn it back off, the bad guys in the immediate area may not reappear, as they will have already been marked as eliminated.
[/list]

The "LUCK" in the game has been improved, so there will be far less "missing" when the player attacks. Originally, there was a "Lucky bracelet" that was in a chest behind the Tavern, that would improve your luck, and reduce misses. Unfortunately many players were not finding and equipping the lucky bracelet, and spending most of the game with a lower than expected "Luck". Now, the lucky bracelet has been eliminated, and you start the game with the increased Luck already in place.

A number of sound problems/levels/issues have been resolved.

Some minor improvements have been implemented to the Camera.

A number of other minor bug fixes have been implemented as well.

We hope you enjoy the new and improved version of WanderLust, and as always, feel free to let us know in the forums if you have any feedback.

Thanks!

notes.title: WanderLust Updated to V1.06
notes.content:
WanderLust has now been updated to Version 1.06. In this update we added a couple of new options, as well as tweaking the player's "LucK" in battle.

[list]
[*]Luck has been increased, so that the player will "miss" and be "blocked" less in battle, especially early on when Else is inexperienced and at lower levels. We want to leave a bit of a challenge, but remove barriers to simply playing and enjoying the game.
[*]A new option is available on the "Options" screen to "Automatically Run". This keeps you from having to hold down the spacebar to run. From now on, Elise will run automatically, and you can hold the spacebar to walk slowly if you choose. This is now the default. If you want to reverse this change, you can uncheck the "Automatic Running" option in the Options scree.
[*]A new option is available to invert the Y-Axes. Players who prefer an inverted Y-Axis control can no go to the "Options" screen from the main menu, and check the "Invert Y-Axis" box. 
[/list]

notes.title: WanderLust Version 1.05 update.
notes.content:
WanderLust has been updated to Version 1.05. This update includes a few bug fixes and additional features as described below:
[olist]
[*]Anti-Aliasing options. From the main menu, under "options" you can now adjust the type of anti-aliasing being used to smooth the visuals of the game. If you are experiencing blurriness when playing, you may want to try out some of the new options available here.
[*]Bug Fix - Running. Under certain circumstances, the player would lose the ability to run while holding the space bar. This has been corrected.
[*]Bug Fix - Mermaid Scenes. Previously if you didn't find the Mermaid, later scenes would not run. There is now a "block" in place, to ensure that you find the Mermaid before progressing past the beach.
[*] A few directional signs to "Bruce's Tavern" have been put in place, to ensure that early in the game, the player knows which direction to go.
[*] The player's initial "Luck" level has been increased slightly, to create less "misses" in battle.
[/olist]
